name: Thomas Massie

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: QUESTION OF PERSONAL PRIVILEGE
statements.title: QUESTION OF PERSONAL PRIVILEGE
sentences: Regrettably, today, I am here to defend my motivations for taking up and supporting the victims of Jeffrey Epstein and the survivors.
A reporter asked him: Mr. Massie got 218 signatures for this Epstein bill to come to the floor on his discharge petition.
The Speaker said: Have never fought getting the Epstein files out.
He refused to schedule the Epstein Files Transparency Act and refuses to schedule the Epstein Files Transparency Act II.
We don't know, but we know the consequence of it was that justice was delayed, and the Epstein Files Transparency Act was delayed for over 1 month because of that.
They are trying to expose a global pedophile ring of billionaires who have been exempt from the system of justice that the rest of us live under.

Now, the text of that resolution is somewhat interesting because until that point and even after that point, the Speaker, in interviews, had described the bill that Ro Khanna and I wrote, the Epstein Files Transparency Act, in various terms that were not kind to our bill.

Another thing where they tried to convince the public and my colleagues and give cover for my colleagues when they resisted releasing the Epstein files or putting our bill forward, was they said in the Oversight and Reform Committee: Oh, my gosh, we just released 30,000 files.
There is no need for the bill, the Epstein Files Transparency Act.

I did talk about it while Biden was President, and he says that our original gambit, he implies when he said that he was trying to maintain principle and balance, he is implying that our original gambit, the Epstein Files Transparency Act did not.
The system of justice where billionaires for three decades can go to their own island and can go to their own ranch and rape women and traffic 14-year-old girls?
Jeffrey Epstein had coconspirators.
That is because this bill the reporter is talking about is the Epstein Files Transparency Act 2.0.
They are cutting off days of our calendar, I believe, to avoid the issues that you all care about: the war, the Epstein files, and justice for the survivors.
He goes on to say: And I have always been for full transparency of the Epstein files.
Our DOJ called the Epstein case closed, in July 2025.
It got the attention of the billionaires.
It got the attention of the police overseas.
We are fighting Congressman Massie and Congressman Ro Khanna.
We will look at it, but they are just ginning this up to get attention.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: QUESTION OF PERSONAL PRIVILEGE
statements.title: QUESTION OF PERSONAL PRIVILEGE
sentences: I am here to get justice for the Epstein victims, the survivors.
What happened a couple of weeks ago is that I introduced the Epstein Files Transparency Act II discharge petition.
If you remember a year ago, we had the Epstein recess, I call it.
We have got to get a 60-vote threshold to overcome the filibuster, and so it is going to be a while.
How long did it take them to pass the Epstein Files Transparency Act?
Well, we will see if we get it on the docket.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BRING EPSTEIN PERPETRATORS TO JUSTICE
statements.title: BRING EPSTEIN PERPETRATORS TO JUSTICE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, it has been a year since the President signed the Epstein Files Transparency Act, and the government continues to withhold over 3 million files.
That is why we have introduced the Epstein Files Transparency Act II, to bring the fight to the State courts, accountability to the Department of Justice, and closure for survivors.

We want perpetrators of these crimes to be investigated and prosecuted, men like: Jes Staley; Leon Black; Les Wexner; David Copperfield; Lapo Elkann; Tom Pritzker; Glenn Dubin; Frederic Fekkai; Eduardo Teodorani; Jean-Luc Brunel, conveniently dead by suicide in prison; Daniel Siad, recently discovered dead in Paris; Ramsey Elkholy; and Prince Andrew, who committed sex crimes in the United States, too; and women like Leslie Groff, not a victim, who conspired with Epstein to traffic other women.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
sentences: It strikes $3.3 billion of foreign aid to the country of Israel from the State Department funding bill.
We have $39.4 trillion of debt.
We are sending more money to Israel in this bill than we spend on homeless veterans in this country.
Madam Chair, $310 billion has been received by Israel from the taxpayers of the United States.
Madam Chair, Israel has the strongest economy in the Middle East.
Their debt per GDP is in much better shape than ours.
I am opposed to all foreign aid.
I offered an amendment to defund Egypt and also to defunding aid to Jordan, which we will talk about in a little bit.
I am particularly concerned this year about the foreign aid to Israel.
American taxpayers should not be conscripted into funding the military adventures of Israel.
Madam Chair, I urge adoption of my amendment, and I yield back the balance of my time.
I think we should end foreign aid to Jordan.
As our debt approaches $40 trillion, it is more and more urgent.

It has been said that foreign aid can be described as taking money from poor people in the United States and giving it to rich people in other countries, and that is what is happening in this instance.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXTENSION OF AUTHORITIES OF TITLE VII OF THE FOREIGN INTELLIGENCE SURVEILLANCE ACT OF 1978
statements.title: EXTENSION OF AUTHORITIES OF TITLE VII OF THE FOREIGN INTELLIGENCE SURVEILLANCE ACT OF 1978
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in opposition to this clean reauthorization of an unconstitutional program that is being used to spy on Americans without warrants.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NICS DATA REPORTING ACT OF 2026
statements.title: NICS DATA REPORTING ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I move to suspend the rules and pass the bill (H.R. 2267) to require the Attorney General to submit to the Congress a report that includes the demographic data of persons determined to be ineligible to purchase a firearm based on a background check performed by the National Instant Criminal Background Check System, as amended.
Mr. Speaker, today we are bringing to the floor the NICS Data Reporting Act.

I became aware of a problem with the NICS background check system because John Lott, who is an author of many books, an economist, and a statistician, worked at the Department of Justice and has been privy to some of this data and has discovered that the NICS background check system doesn't work like we think it does, or may actually, in fact, have a racial prejudice built into it.
The NICS system--that stands for National Instant Criminal Background Check System--is a program that was instituted many years ago that you have to go through when you want to purchase a firearm.

What happens when it does this check is the computers will look for phonetically similar names, and if you share a name, unfortunately, with somebody who is a criminal, even if you are not a convicted criminal yourself, you could be denied the purchase of a firearm.

If you looked at the data, what you will find is that Black Americans are three times more likely to get a false denial in the NICS background check system and that Hispanic Americans are twice as likely to get a false denial from the NICS background check system as a White American might be.
We want to know these numbers in the aggregate so that nobody's particular traits or names will be disclosed as gun owners.
Mr. Speaker, banks also do background checks on prospective tellers and employees of the banks.
Imagine if a bank had an error in their system that caused Black tellers or Hispanic tellers to fail the background check more than White tellers or other bank employees.

It will also mean that all races, whether you are White, Black, Hispanic, or Asian, and whether you are male or female, there will be no bias because we will check for your actual name and your actual birthday and clean this system up.
We will find out not just the demographics of the denials but also the demographics of the people who overturned their denials.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXTENSION OF AUTHORITIES OF TITLE VII OF THE FOREIGN INTELLIGENCE SURVEILLANCE ACT OF 1978
statements.title: EXTENSION OF AUTHORITIES OF TITLE VII OF THE FOREIGN INTELLIGENCE SURVEILLANCE ACT OF 1978
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I yield 3 minutes to the gentleman from Ohio (Mr. Davidson), who serves on the Finance Committee and has warned us about the Orwellian dangers and powers of the central bank digital currency.
I rise in opposition to this clean reauthorization of FISA and, in particular, to this short-term authorization of FISA.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: JUSTICE FOR EPSTEIN VICTIMS
statements.title: JUSTICE FOR EPSTEIN VICTIMS
sentences: I have not seen any arrests from the revelations in the Epstein files, over 3 million documents describing horrible things, describing unspeakable things, much of it redacted.
Prince Andrew, Duke of York, who has since been stripped of his royal titles due to his affiliation with Jeffrey Epstein, has been arrested.
We see our FBI Director celebrating in the locker room at the Olympics overseas.
The Epstein Files Transparency Act requires the DOJ and FBI to disclose to us their internal memos and emails about how they made those decisions, whether to prosecute or not prosecute.

We still don't have the memos, documents, and emails from 2008 to explain why Jeffrey Epstein was given such a light sentence in what would have been an open-and-shut case of child sex trafficking, which allowed him to go back and recommit these terrible crimes, create hundreds more victims, and ensnare so many other people in his conspiracy.
The Attorney General has opined favorably for this German company in front of the Supreme Court, about getting rid of any liability that they should have for any damages.
I will tell you what I have not seen.
I will name them right here: Leon Black: You don't even have to see past the redactions to see that this man needs to be investigated.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AMENDMENT NO. 1 OFFERED BY MR. MASSIE
statements.title: AMENDMENT NO. 1 OFFERED BY MR. MASSIE
sentences: However, there is a law that states that every vehicle manufactured is going to have to have a kill switch in it.
Are you really going to send a police car after this disabled vehicle?
It is just a bad idea, but it is in law, so our amendment would defund that.
It would defund an unconstitutional and unworkable mandate that has already missed the deadlines.
Mr. Chair, I rise in support of our amendment.
What I am going to describe will probably sound like a bad science fiction movie, but that is what is written into law.
Her car says: You have one more swerve, and then we are going to ground you.
I urge my colleagues to vote for this amendment.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REMOVAL OF THE USE OF UNITED STATES FORCES FOR HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST VENEZUELA
statements.title: REMOVAL OF THE USE OF UNITED STATES FORCES FOR HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST VENEZUELA
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of this War Powers Resolution because the integrity of this institution is in question.
The executive's military exercise to capture the leader of Venezuela represents one of the most blatant usurpations of congressional authority we have seen in modern times.
It was the Attorney General who explained this was just a law enforcement action that the military was merely assisting.

If the unilateral use of force was not enough, then the executive has compounded this abuse by seizing Venezuela's oil revenues, selling them, and depositing that money in U.S. Treasury-controlled accounts overseas.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REMOVAL OF THE USE OF UNITED STATES FORCES FOR HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST VENEZUELA
statements.title: REMOVAL OF THE USE OF UNITED STATES FORCES FOR HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST VENEZUELA
sentences: If the President believes military action against Venezuela is justified and needed, he should make the case, and Congress should vote before American lives and treasure are spent on regime change in South America.
This is about oil and regime change.
When it comes to regime change, we have already been down this road with Venezuela with nothing to show for it.
We seized their embassy here in D.C. We were told that regime change was imminent.
At the same time, this administration has moved to end temporary protected status for hundreds of thousands of Venezuelans and deports them back to the very regime it condemns.

All we are voting on is a war powers resolution that strengthens the fabric of our Republic by reasserting the plain and simple language in the Constitution that Congress must decide questions of war.
Mr. Speaker, I urge support for this resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF S.J. RES. 80, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF LAND MANAGEMENT RELATING TO "NATIONAL PE
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF S.J. RES. 80, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF LAND MANAGEMENT RELATING TO "NATIONAL PETROLEUM RESERVE IN ALASKA...
sentences: Transparency will triumph over dark money.
It is going to be a victory for survivors; not just survivors of the Epstein sex trafficking scandal, but the 1,000 survivors who exist.
Anybody who has been a victim of sexual assault, or maybe they have been victimized by a family member, maybe it is not a billionaire, but they are all waiting and watching to see what we do today.
They are victims of the Epstein class.

I begrudge nobody's success if they become a billionaire, but if you think being a billionaire or buying politicians keeps you out of the judicial system, lets you rape young women, lets you traffic women, you have another thing coming when this bill passes.
I am sorry if one of their billionaire donors is going to get embarrassed because he went to rape island.
If my colleagues will vote for this measure, then we will see justice triumph over politics.
We are going to help them claim that back.
We will know when there are men, rich men, in handcuffs being perp-walked to the jail.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my Senate colleagues: Do not muck up this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: This bill is a debt bomb ticking.
Moody's downgraded our credit rating, and the bond investors who buy and finance our debt demanded higher interest rates on the 10-year note, 20-year note, and the 30-year note.
Under the taxing and spending levels in this bill, we are going to rack up, the authors say, $20 trillion of new debt over the next 10 years.
I am telling you, it is closer to $30 trillion of new debt in the next 10 years.
Instead of taking care of that problem, we are going to give them a $1,600 tax break.
Mr. Speaker, I oppose this bill.
